data.title: 空门苍 · 御神木下的深宵秘事
data.description: 满月洒在幽暗的后山御神木下。巫女服的白色襦袢散乱开来，苍双手攀着粗壮的树干，绯袴被完全褪至膝头，在夏夜清凉的山风中发出了甜腻的娇喘。
data.location: secluded clearing beneath gigantic ancient sacred cedar tied with shimenawa ropes
data.action: 巫女服的白色襦袢散乱开来，苍双手攀着粗壮的树干，绯袴被完全褪至膝头
data.lighting: luminous full moon casting dramatic silver beams and deep forest shadows
data.promptProse: Beneath the massive sacred tree behind the mountain shrine at midnight, Ao presses both palms into the furrowed bark while looking back over her shoulder. Cool silver moonlight filters through the canopy onto her flushed cheek.
data.animaCaption: Bracing both hands against the rough trunk of the sacred tree at midnight, she wears her white miko top splayed loose and scarlet hakama pulled down to her knees, baring her hips as she glances back breathless in the moonlight.
data.nsfwProse: Her white wide-sleeved miko kosode hangs disheveled off her shoulders and her scarlet hakama is pulled down around her knees, leaving her hips and rear bare to the night air.
